source.name: SportsPro: 'Toronto FC ink ten-year BMO shirt sponsorship and naming rights renewal'
source.quote: Toronto FC have signed a ten-year extension of their foundational partnership with the Bank of Montreal (BMO) financial group.
source.note: The 2022 renewal keeps BMO as TFC's main shirt sponsor for the duration of the contract. FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list (2026-02-17, https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/) confirms BMO Financial Group is on the front of Toronto FC's 2026 shirt.

source.name: Toronto FC: 'LG Electronics Canada named new sleeve patch partner of Toronto FC'
source.quote: The new partnership will introduce the LG logo on the right sleeve of the team’s jerseys this season.
source.note: Multi-year partnership announced 17 July 2024; FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list (2026-02-17) still shows LG Electronics as Toronto FC's right-sleeve partner.

source.name: SportsLogos.Net: 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

summary: Toronto FC's 2026-27 home kit is the red 'Club Kit' introduced in February 2025 and worn for a second season. BMO - the club's shirt sponsor since its first season in 2007, renewed for ten years in June 2022 - is on the front; LG Electronics is the right-sleeve patch partner (announced July 2024); the league-wide Apple TV+ patch sits on the left sleeve. No back-of-jersey advert: MLS opened the lower-back spot only after the 2026 All-Star break, and no TFC back sponsor has been announced.
